finding.message: A saved formula is compiled into a function with the Function constructor.

reason: new Function compiles a program: it hands back something the module calls later, with the saved string deciding what runs, so no data parser stands in for it the way JSON.parse stands in for an eval of a document. Replacing it means deciding what a formula is allowed to compute, which is a design decision rather than a rewrite, so the engine skips the finding as dynamic_code_unsupported. The eval family is otherwise supported for JavaScript: js-eval-request-body is repaired.
